subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw expose `resetSessionEntryLifecycle` as a stable public Plugin SDK/session-ownership contract, including locked-harness reset handoff, to support observable channel lifecycle boundaries?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but choosing a permanent public cross-plugin API and its harness-owner responsibilities is a product and architecture decision that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Approve the narrow generic seam
options.body: Accept the documented lifecycle-reset API as a stable generic primitive, with the existing ownership checks and locked-harness handoff contract.

options.title: Keep the capability owner-local
options.body: Avoid expanding the public SDK and require a narrower Msteams-specific or existing-owner integration path before landing.

options.title: Pause for contract design
options.body: Defer this PR until session and plugin owners define the supported lifecycle-reset API and compatibility guarantees.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow generic seam
recommendation.body: Accept the documented lifecycle-reset API as a stable generic primitive, with the existing ownership checks and locked-harness handoff contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Msteams and channel-boundary history makes this the best available owner candidate for the API-boundary decision.
